data.one_liner: Preview pictures with left and right sliding switch in full screen.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to open full-screen picture previews with support for left and right sliding switches. It also supports video playback capabilities using internal dependencies like video_player.
use_when: You need to provide a full-screen image and video gallery preview with sliding navigation.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single static image container without zoom or gallery capabilities.
strengths: Supports left and right sliding switch between pictures.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of a basic README and example link.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides robust pan and zoom capabilities for images if you want to build custom galleries.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited if you only need efficient image loading and caching rather than a full-screen gallery viewer.
